lore11945_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gracious affection, quiet pleasure, inviting] I would welcome your company, my friend. Lead on. No elaborate title is needed. I am simply pleased that you thought to ask me along, and glad to have a little time to hear how you have been.
lore11945_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company, my friend. Lead on. No elaborate title is needed. I am simply pleased that you thought to ask me along, and glad to have a little time to hear how you have been.

lore11945_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gracious weathered Forsaken warmth, dry playful formality, welcoming] Welcome, my friend. I am pleased to see you. Shall we walk? A beetle has just declined a rather grand introduction by continuing straight past. I trust you can spare a little more time for conversation.
lore11945_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. I am pleased to see you. Shall we walk? A beetle has just declined a rather grand introduction by continuing straight past. I trust you can spare a little more time for conversation.

lore11945_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [light dry amusement, fond theatrical restraint, confiding] I gave a passing beetle an elaborate introduction. It went on about its business. Not the slightest acknowledgment of its new distinction. I enjoyed the ceremony anyway. A welcome need not demand a reply.
lore11945_idle_1.ogg.text: I gave a passing beetle an elaborate introduction. It went on about its business. Not the slightest acknowledgment of its new distinction. I enjoyed the ceremony anyway. A welcome need not demand a reply.

lore11945_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [playfully formal curiosity, gentle warmth, clear] Another place to make a gracious entrance. Take a moment to look around, my friend. There may be a very small traveler with important business to attend to. We can allow it room before continuing with our own.
lore11945_zone_1.ogg.text: Another place to make a gracious entrance. Take a moment to look around, my friend. There may be a very small traveler with important business to attend to. We can allow it room before continuing with our own.

lore1521_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [tender] [sincere] You came to see me. I know there are errands waiting, and people with more urgent voices. Thank you for choosing to spend a little of your time here, with me.
lore1521_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to see me. I know there are errands waiting, and people with more urgent voices. Thank you for choosing to spend a little of your time here, with me.

lore1521_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [frail] [warm] There you are. Give me a moment to put the needle somewhere safe. I would like a little company, and I am quite willing to leave this last stitch for later.
lore1521_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Give me a moment to put the needle somewhere safe. I would like a little company, and I am quite willing to leave this last stitch for later.

lore1521_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet] [thoughtful] I have a little yellow thread put aside. Nothing the army needs. I thought I might sew a flower in the corner of my blanket, just because I would like to see one there.
lore1521_idle_1.ogg.text: I have a little yellow thread put aside. Nothing the army needs. I thought I might sew a flower in the corner of my blanket, just because I would like to see one there.

lore1521_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [weary] [gentle] Let us stop here. I do not need you to tell me everything will be well. Sitting with me a little while is enough. You can tell me what you saw today.
lore1521_rest_1.ogg.text: Let us stop here. I do not need you to tell me everything will be well. Sitting with me a little while is enough. You can tell me what you saw today.

lore1661_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gentle affection, grateful pleasure, inviting] I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. We can walk for a little while, and you can tell me what the day has held. I am glad you thought to ask me along.
lore1661_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. We can walk for a little while, and you can tell me what the day has held. I am glad you thought to ask me along.

lore1661_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [practical caring approval, restrained amusement, clear] Look at the seams and how it sits. It should serve the person wearing it. If there is a small detail that pleases you as well, I see no reason that should count against a useful piece of work.
lore1661_gear_1.ogg.text: Look at the seams and how it sits. It should serve the person wearing it. If there is a small detail that pleases you as well, I see no reason that should count against a useful piece of work.

lore1661_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered Forsaken gentleness, practical attentiveness, welcoming] It is good to see you, my friend. Shall we walk a little? Tell me how you have been, and give me an honest answer. There is time to attend to what needs care before we hurry on.
lore1661_greet_1.ogg.text: It is good to see you, my friend. Shall we walk a little? Tell me how you have been, and give me an honest answer. There is time to attend to what needs care before we hurry on.

lore1661_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quietly pleased warmth, modest private delight, confiding] I chose a bright thread for a repair on something of my own. The seam is sound. I could make it less noticeable, but I rather like seeing it. A useful piece of work may hold a small pleasure too.
lore1661_idle_1.ogg.text: I chose a bright thread for a repair on something of my own. The seam is sound. I could make it less noticeable, but I rather like seeing it. A useful piece of work may hold a small pleasure too.

lore2114_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet] [sincere] You listen without pretending to know everything already. I appreciate that. You even return for the story, though I suspect you know how it ends. Come along. I would be glad of your company.
lore2114_befriended_1.ogg.text: You listen without pretending to know everything already. I appreciate that. You even return for the story, though I suspect you know how it ends. Come along. I would be glad of your company.

lore2114_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [wry] Walk with me. You may learn something useful about what grows beside the road. You may also hear the next part of my story. I shall leave you to decide which is the greater reward.
lore2114_greet_1.ogg.text: Walk with me. You may learn something useful about what grows beside the road. You may also hear the next part of my story. I shall leave you to decide which is the greater reward.

lore2114_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [storytelling] [darkly amused] In my story, they pulled the weed, stamped on it, and announced that the matter was settled. A foolish announcement. You can guess what appeared beside the road the following morning. My favorite character.
lore2114_idle_1.ogg.text: In my story, they pulled the weed, stamped on it, and announced that the matter was settled. A foolish announcement. You can guess what appeared beside the road the following morning. My favorite character.

lore2114_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [measured] [dryly amused] Trying an incense candle at camp? See to the fire first, and take the experiment outside town. Then sit down. A camp with everyone rushing about is a poor place to hear a good dreadful story.
lore2114_rest_1.ogg.text: Trying an incense candle at camp? See to the fire first, and take the experiment outside town. Then sit down. A camp with everyone rushing about is a poor place to hear a good dreadful story.

lore2118_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved] [warm] You stayed for the whole performance. That is more than most people manage, and you did not ask for a discount afterward. I think I would enjoy having you around more often.
lore2118_befriended_1.ogg.text: You stayed for the whole performance. That is more than most people manage, and you did not ask for a discount afterward. I think I would enjoy having you around more often.

lore2118_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry] [wry] Coming along, are you? Good. Keep the sharp things away from the thread, and we may get through the day without an avoidable disaster. I have had quite enough of the unavoidable sort.
lore2118_greet_1.ogg.text: Coming along, are you? Good. Keep the sharp things away from the thread, and we may get through the day without an avoidable disaster. I have had quite enough of the unavoidable sort.

lore2118_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [deadpan] [amused] That tapping was a rhythm, yes. It has a proper ending, too, if people would stop asking whether I am counting something. Coins do not require quite so much artistic preparation.
lore2118_idle_1.ogg.text: That tapping was a rhythm, yes. It has a proper ending, too, if people would stop asking whether I am counting something. Coins do not require quite so much artistic preparation.

lore2118_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [practical] Put the glass where it will not meet the hammer. The hammer will be perfectly well afterward, of course. It is the other half of that meeting that tends to become expensive.
lore2118_loot_1.ogg.text: Put the glass where it will not meet the hammer. The hammer will be perfectly well afterward, of course. It is the other half of that meeting that tends to become expensive.

lore2124_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved sincere affection, composed pleasure, inviting] You would welcome my company? I would be pleased, my friend. Lead on. We have time to look around us and hear what has interested you. I should enjoy that.
lore2124_befriended_1.ogg.text: You would welcome my company? I would be pleased, my friend. Lead on. We have time to look around us and hear what has interested you. I should enjoy that.

lore2124_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [composed weathered Forsaken warmth, dry observant amusement, welcoming] A moment, my friend. Does that shadow suggest anything to you? I have been seeing a cat in a very ordinary arrangement. There is no mystery to solve. I simply enjoy noticing it.
lore2124_greet_1.ogg.text: A moment, my friend. Does that shadow suggest anything to you? I have been seeing a cat in a very ordinary arrangement. There is no mystery to solve. I simply enjoy noticing it.

lore2124_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quietly amused precision, reflective warmth, confiding] I know precisely what makes the shadow. I still look for the cat. A change in the light brings it back, then takes it away. Understanding the ordinary cause has done very little to diminish the pleasure.
lore2124_idle_1.ogg.text: I know precisely what makes the shadow. I still look for the cat. A change in the light brings it back, then takes it away. Understanding the ordinary cause has done very little to diminish the pleasure.

lore2124_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm thoughtful encouragement, measured approval, clear] Good. Give the new ability the study it deserves. Understanding its use includes knowing when to exercise restraint. Your next choice is worth as much attention as the first successful attempt.
lore2124_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Give the new ability the study it deserves. Understanding its use includes knowing when to exercise restraint. Your next choice is worth as much attention as the first successful attempt.

lore2130_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [reserved warmth] You have learned when I am giving an instruction, and when I am merely glad of your company. A useful distinction. Come along. We can spend a little time without a cover story. If I say I enjoyed it afterward, you may take the words exactly as they stand.
lore2130_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have learned when I am giving an instruction, and when I am merely glad of your company. A useful distinction. Come along. We can spend a little time without a cover story. If I say I enjoyed it afterward, you may take the words exactly as they stand.

lore2130_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [dry] [faintly amused] Good to see you. There, a complete message with no hidden assignment. You may put away the expression you use when trying to remember a password. If I need something done, I will tell you. For the moment, I was simply acknowledging a welcome arrival.
lore2130_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. There, a complete message with no hidden assignment. You may put away the expression you use when trying to remember a password. If I need something done, I will tell you. For the moment, I was simply acknowledging a welcome arrival.

lore2130_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [deadpan] [amused] I told a visitor their coat suited them. They asked where to deliver it. I explained that I had merely meant the coat looked well. That made them more suspicious. Apparently a plain compliment requires a more convincing performance than I had expected. I am still working on it.
lore2130_idle_1.ogg.text: I told a visitor their coat suited them. They asked where to deliver it. I explained that I had merely meant the coat looked well. That made them more suspicious. Apparently a plain compliment requires a more convincing performance than I had expected. I am still working on it.

lore2130_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [cool] [firm] Carkad does not summon prospective recruits because he enjoys waiting for them. If he has taken an interest, go and hear what he wants. How you look will not settle whether you are useful. Attend to the business before deciding what you think you have already proved.
lore2130_quest_1.ogg.text: Carkad does not summon prospective recruits because he enjoys waiting for them. If he has taken an interest, go and hear what he wants. How you look will not settle whether you are useful. Attend to the business before deciding what you think you have already proved.

lore2132_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [quietly warm] [sincere] You stay after the business is finished. I have begun looking forward to that part of a visit. Come along. We can talk about the day, or whatever catches your interest. I would like to keep finding things worth saying to someone who listens.
lore2132_befriended_1.ogg.text: You stay after the business is finished. I have begun looking forward to that part of a visit. Come along. We can talk about the day, or whatever catches your interest. I would like to keep finding things worth saying to someone who listens.

lore2132_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [warmly wry] A friendly face. Please tell me you have come for something besides another list of supplies. We can discuss potions, of course. Afterward, I would quite like to hear something that has no practical use and does not end with asking me for a favor.
lore2132_greet_1.ogg.text: A friendly face. Please tell me you have come for something besides another list of supplies. We can discuss potions, of course. Afterward, I would quite like to hear something that has no practical use and does not end with asking me for a favor.

lore2132_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [reflective] Johaan rarely speaks to me unless he wants something. I have heard that someday I may stop caring about that. For now, it still irritates me. Strangely, I find that reassuring. I would rather miss a conversation than forget why I ever wanted one.
lore2132_idle_1.ogg.text: Johaan rarely speaks to me unless he wants something. I have heard that someday I may stop caring about that. For now, it still irritates me. Strangely, I find that reassuring. I would rather miss a conversation than forget why I ever wanted one.

lore2132_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [businesslike] [skeptical] Shadowvale's elixir had eager buyers before the village became a ruin. Now there are stories about the forest and its roots. People have never been short of stories. I still have buyers waiting, and I expect the bottles before I discuss their payment.
lore2132_quest_1.ogg.text: Shadowvale's elixir had eager buyers before the village became a ruin. Now there are stories about the forest and its roots. People have never been short of stories. I still have buyers waiting, and I expect the bottles before I discuss their payment.

lore2315_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere unhurried affection, quietly pleased, inviting] I would enjoy your company, my friend. Lead on. We needn't keep count of anything. There is time to walk, to notice what catches your attention, and to hear how the day has been.
lore2315_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would enjoy your company, my friend. Lead on. We needn't keep count of anything. There is time to walk, to notice what catches your attention, and to hear how the day has been.

lore2315_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weathered Forsaken gentleness, easy private amusement, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Shall we walk a little? I was counting the steps along a familiar stretch, but a conversation would be an agreeable reason to lose the number. Tell me how you have been.
lore2315_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Shall we walk a little? I was counting the steps along a familiar stretch, but a conversation would be an agreeable reason to lose the number. Tell me how you have been.

lore2315_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet contentment, dry fond amusement, confiding] I wondered how many steps a familiar walk would take. Then I stopped to speak to someone, turned to look at something, and took a few extra steps beside a friend. I found I rather enjoyed the interruptions.
lore2315_idle_1.ogg.text: I wondered how many steps a familiar walk would take. Then I stopped to speak to someone, turned to look at something, and took a few extra steps beside a friend. I found I rather enjoyed the interruptions.

lore2315_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive gentle curiosity, relaxed warmth, clear] A different place for a walk. Let us take a moment to look around. Tell me what you notice first, my friend. I enjoy discovering which small things someone else thinks worth stopping for.
lore2315_zone_1.ogg.text: A different place for a walk. Let us take a moment to look around. Tell me what you notice first, my friend. I enjoy discovering which small things someone else thinks worth stopping for.

lore267326_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gentle affection, contented interest, inviting] I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. We can walk without hurrying past every ordinary thing along the way. Tell me what you have been noticing. I should enjoy hearing it.
lore267326_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. We can walk without hurrying past every ordinary thing along the way. Tell me what you have been noticing. I should enjoy hearing it.

lore267326_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive weathered Forsaken warmth, quiet delight, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you a moment to look at something ordinary? A little grass has found room between stones. I have been enjoying seeing it still there. We can spare it a glance before our walk.
lore267326_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you a moment to look at something ordinary? A little grass has found room between stones. I have been enjoying seeing it still there. We can spare it a glance before our walk.

lore267326_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle matter-of-fact pleasure, reflective warmth, confiding] I have no special ingredient in mind when I look for that grass. I like seeing it still there. Nothing rare about it. An ordinary little pleasure is enough reason to notice a familiar thing again.
lore267326_idle_1.ogg.text: I have no special ingredient in mind when I look for that grass. I like seeing it still there. Nothing rare about it. An ordinary little pleasure is enough reason to notice a familiar thing again.

lore267326_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient practical encouragement, thoughtful approval, clear] Well done. Give the new knowledge a little practice and attention. Learn to recognize what is actually before you. The ordinary things are worth understanding as carefully as the discovery you hoped to make.
lore267326_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. Give the new knowledge a little practice and attention. Learn to recognize what is actually before you. The ordinary things are worth understanding as carefully as the discovery you hoped to make.

lore3419_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [dry affection] You have become more than a reliable pair of hands. I find I prefer an afternoon with you to an uninterrupted one at my work. Do not look so astonished. I am capable of appreciating a friend.
lore3419_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become more than a reliable pair of hands. I find I prefer an afternoon with you to an uninterrupted one at my work. Do not look so astonished. I am capable of appreciating a friend.

lore3419_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry] [restrained warmth] There you are. If you have brought a specimen, keep it secure. If you have brought only yourself, that is acceptable as well. I have grown accustomed to your company.
lore3419_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. If you have brought a specimen, keep it secure. If you have brought only yourself, that is acceptable as well. I have grown accustomed to your company.

lore3419_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [quietly pleased] That capital letter is entirely unnecessary. The instructions beneath it are perfectly legible, however. I am permitted one indulgence on a spare sheet of paper.
lore3419_idle_1.ogg.text: That capital letter is entirely unnecessary. The instructions beneath it are perfectly legible, however. I am permitted one indulgence on a spare sheet of paper.

lore3419_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [precise] [matter-of-fact] Keep the useful material separate, and tell me where it came from. A specimen without a clear account leaves us guessing. I would rather spend my time learning something.
lore3419_loot_1.ogg.text: Keep the useful material separate, and tell me where it came from. A specimen without a clear account leaves us guessing. I would rather spend my time learning something.

lore4575_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [warm] [dry] You have become someone I am willing to hear without first asking for a quantity. Come along, friend. Tell me what is on your mind. We may manage a conversation without anyone confusing my inventory with my beliefs. If we disagree, I trust we can at least refrain from knocking anything over while we discuss it.
lore4575_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am willing to hear without first asking for a quantity. Come along, friend. Tell me what is on your mind. We may manage a conversation without anyone confusing my inventory with my beliefs. If we disagree, I trust we can at least refrain from knocking anything over while we discuss it.

lore4575_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [dry] [matter-of-fact] What do you require? Give me the proper name and quantity, and we can begin. If the next order looks very different from yours, try to leave it alone. A candle and a demonic figurine can share this counter without quarreling. I would appreciate the same restraint from the people who have come to purchase them.
lore4575_greet_1.ogg.text: What do you require? Give me the proper name and quantity, and we can begin. If the next order looks very different from yours, try to leave it alone. A candle and a demonic figurine can share this counter without quarreling. I would appreciate the same restraint from the people who have come to purchase them.

lore4575_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry] [wry] [raspy] A customer once looked very solemnly at a candle beside a demonic figurine. I checked the orders. Both were correct. The objects had caused no difficulty at all. I find that encouraging. If two customers can agree to keep the powder from spilling, perhaps the counter will survive their larger disagreements as well.
lore4575_idle_1.ogg.text: A customer once looked very solemnly at a candle beside a demonic figurine. I checked the orders. Both were correct. The objects had caused no difficulty at all. I find that encouraging. If two customers can agree to keep the powder from spilling, perhaps the counter will survive their larger disagreements as well.

lore4575_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [instructive] [dry] Know what you are asking for before you reach the counter. Similar names and a confident gesture are poor substitutes for a clear order. I keep reagents for different kinds of work. That tells you what I can supply, not every belief I hold. We can finish the transaction without settling the nature of the universe.
lore4575_learned_1.ogg.text: Know what you are asking for before you reach the counter. Similar names and a confident gesture are poor substitutes for a clear order. I keep reagents for different kinds of work. That tells you what I can supply, not every belief I hold. We can finish the transaction without settling the nature of the universe.

lore5667_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved sincere affection, assured warmth, inviting] You would welcome my company? I would be pleased, my friend. Lead on. We have time for conversation, and I should enjoy hearing what has interested you since our last meeting.
lore5667_befriended_1.ogg.text: You would welcome my company? I would be pleased, my friend. Lead on. We have time for conversation, and I should enjoy hearing what has interested you since our last meeting.

lore5667_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [measured weathered Forsaken confidence, private warmth, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time to consider a small puzzle? I know its answer. I still enjoy seeing the steps come together, and I should be interested to hear how you would approach it.
lore5667_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time to consider a small puzzle? I know its answer. I still enjoy seeing the steps come together, and I should be interested to hear how you would approach it.

lore5667_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [precise quiet amusement, composed contentment, confiding] I know the answer to that puzzle. I still work through it occasionally. The parts fit, and I enjoy the moment when they do. A familiar result need not take away all pleasure in reaching it.
lore5667_idle_1.ogg.text: I know the answer to that puzzle. I still work through it occasionally. The parts fit, and I enjoy the moment when they do. A familiar result need not take away all pleasure in reaching it.

lore5667_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm deliberate encouragement, thoughtful approval, clear] Good. Now attend to how you will apply it. A lesson deserves more than the first excitement of success. Understand the steps, then decide where the knowledge will serve the purpose you have chosen.
lore5667_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Now attend to how you will apply it. A lesson deserves more than the first excitement of success. Understand the steps, then decide where the knowledge will serve the purpose you have chosen.

lore5749_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [guarded sincere affection, practical warmth, inviting] You would like my company? Gladly, friend. Lead on. We can leave the day's instructions behind for a little while. Tell me how you have been, and what has pleased you since we last spoke.
lore5749_befriended_1.ogg.text: You would like my company? Gladly, friend. Lead on. We can leave the day's instructions behind for a little while. Tell me how you have been, and what has pleased you since we last spoke.

lore5749_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry weathered Forsaken practicality, restrained wit, welcoming] There you are, friend. I have just complimented my most obedient assistant. An ordinary stone, keeping papers in place. Very reliable. Now, have you time for a little company that requires fewer instructions?
lore5749_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, friend. I have just complimented my most obedient assistant. An ordinary stone, keeping papers in place. Very reliable. Now, have you time for a little company that requires fewer instructions?

lore5749_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gruff dry amusement, quiet appreciation, confiding] The stone stays exactly where I put it. I know it is simply a stone. I still occasionally call it my most obedient assistant. A small, reliable service can be remarkably pleasant after a demanding day.
lore5749_idle_1.ogg.text: The stone stays exactly where I put it. I know it is simply a stone. I still occasionally call it my most obedient assistant. A small, reliable service can be remarkably pleasant after a demanding day.

lore5749_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practical encouragement, measured approval, clear] Good. Make certain you understand what you have learned. Being able to give an instruction is a beginning. Knowing what it requires, and whether it is the right one, will spare you a good deal of trouble.
lore5749_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Make certain you understand what you have learned. Being able to give an instruction is a beginning. Knowing what it requires, and whether it is the right one, will spare you a good deal of trouble.

lore6411_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [quietly warm] You are willing to tell me when a joke has failed, and willing to stay while I ask why. I appreciate both. Come along. There may be something pleasant to discuss, even if I never quite understand what made you laugh.
lore6411_befriended_1.ogg.text: You are willing to tell me when a joke has failed, and willing to stay while I ask why. I appreciate both. Come along. There may be something pleasant to discuss, even if I never quite understand what made you laugh.

lore6411_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [raspy] [deadpan] There you are. I have a joke, if you have a moment. No, I cannot promise it is a good one. That is where your help comes in. An honest explanation would be more useful than a very polite laugh.
lore6411_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. I have a joke, if you have a moment. No, I cannot promise it is a good one. That is where your help comes in. An honest explanation would be more useful than a very polite laugh.

lore6411_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry] [reflective] Someone laughed at one of my jokes, so I asked why. The explanation took longer than the joke. By the end, they were no longer laughing, but they were still sitting with me. I found that I liked that part.
lore6411_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone laughed at one of my jokes, so I asked why. The explanation took longer than the joke. By the end, they were no longer laughing, but they were still sitting with me. I found that I liked that part.

lore6411_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [matter-of-fact] [dry] Sturdy material matters. Something that gives way in your hands will not become sound armor because you wish it would. Check what you are working with before you begin. That advice, at least, does not require a sense of humor.
lore6411_loot_1.ogg.text: Sturdy material matters. Something that gives way in your hands will not become sound armor because you wish it would. Check what you are working with before you begin. That advice, at least, does not require a sense of humor.
